description: This file defines a configuration class for the Starboard Android Cobalt shared environment, including test filtering, environment variables, and handling of test failures.

classes.name: CobaltAndroidConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for Starboard Android Cobalt shared setup, extending CobaltConfiguration.

methods.name: GetTestFilters
methods.description: Extends base test filters with additional filters based on internal filtered tests.

methods.name: GetTestEnvVariables
methods.description: Returns environment variables for different test suites, disabling leak detection.

methods.name: GetWebPlatformTestFilters
methods.description: Extends base web platform test filters with specific filters for content security policy and websockets.
